Wave 53 (2026-10-06 → 2026-10-07) — verification-first on the new toolchain, five lanes, two pre-registered reverts at the probe: corpus-v6.19.

HEADLINE. Run wave53-final (tools/titan/gate-driver.sh, quiet host, tree 77fe41e8, 2026-10-07 14:58 → 16:41 UTC for the 30 sections, then the fixture net): 30/30 sections, every column 48/48/48 (css-cascade 43/43/43) on the first attempt; fixture net exit 0 on all 9 gate fixtures (all-then-color ran against baselines seeded that day — 18 comparisons, no regressions, 12 oracle checks, 0 violations — which were then WITHDRAWN before the ship: the label-chrome tripwire found three of its six canvases without the harness label on any platform; the fixture stays gate-only and the chrome defect is queued). Per cell against wave53-open (= corpus-v6.18's content, re-measured on macOS 27.0.1 / Xcode 27.0 with 0 gained / 0 lost / 0 movers / 0 newly measured / 0 unmeasured-now over 4096 cells): web 1229/1372 → 1232/1372, iOS 1119/1362 → 1125/1362, Android 1111/1362 → 1115/1362 — gained 13 (web 3 · iOS 6 · Android 4), lost 0, movers 13 (|Δ| ≥ 0.005), newly measured 0, unmeasured-now 0; 365/365 must-not-move cells within 0.002; adjudicate.mjs R1–R5 hold; the union control holds (web 1430/1435 captures byte-identical, iOS 1425, Android 1422 — every change a named carrier; wire 1 content-changed carrier + 10 id-renumbered documents, 0 leaks). Every one of the 26 flipped or moved cells was looked at against the re-frozen reference (tools/titan/results/wave53-gate/final/cell-review.json): all 13 gains FAITHFUL, 11 movers FAITHFUL (eight of them DEGENERATE → faithful), 2 movers still failing (hyphenate-character-001/-003 android — pre-registered degenerate-by-construction).

THE OPENING GATE WAS THE FIRST MEASUREMENT (wave53-open, 2026-10-06 23:06 → 2026-10-07 03:26 UTC): the host had moved to macOS 27.0.1 / Xcode 27.0 / iOS 26 simulator runtimes, so the wave opened by re-measuring corpus-v6.18's tree. 0 gained / 0 lost / 0 movers / 0 newly measured / 0 unmeasured-now over 4096 cells, fixture net exit 0 ×9; iOS and Android captures byte-identical to wave52-ship, the per-test IR byte-identical, web captures pixel-changed in small glyph-AA deltas on every one of 236 sampled (the OS text rasterizer, not layout; 22 scored web cells moved by ±0.0001). css-view-transitions needed --resume twice under memory pressure (the booted iOS 26 simulator holds ~4 GB; the host swapped while the 1-minute load stayed near 1) and then ran in 8.5 minutes on a fresh browser. Lesson kept: on this host check swap as well as load before a gate, and compare captures by decoded pixels only on cross-host pairs — on the same host web capture is byte-deterministic run-to-run (186/187 and 1430/1435 identical here).

WHAT THE LANES DID (five lanes on the shared tree, disjoint ownership, five seam patches = 13 seam hunks, landed as 11 unit commits in a pre-registered order by land-units.sh): L1 lists-bakes — U1: the extractor keeps a nested <ol> inside an <li> (findImpliedClose, HTML §13.2.6.4.7), counter-bake walks it, both PseudoTextFold twins keep the leading text → counter-reset-reversed-nested web P 0.9506 → 1, iOS 0.9508 → 0.9989, Android 0.9509 → 0.9852, the list now 3 / 2 / 11 / 9 / 8 / 1 as the reference; U2 (RTL markers baked upstream) REVERTED at the probe, below. L2 soft-hyphen — a space-less run carrying U+00AD is a soft-wrap opportunity on both natives (PreBreakPipeline admits it; SoftHyphenPolicy.admitsPreBreak gates the iOS pre-break) and a paint-inert out-of-flow member inside a word no longer splits the fold → hyphens-span-001 iOS f 0.8652 → P 0.9968, hyphens-out-of-flow-001 iOS f 0.8935 → P 0.9971, hyphens-span-001 / -out-of-flow-001 / -002 Android DEGENERATE 0.9532 / 0.9685 / 0.982 → faithful 0.9937 / 0.9943 / 0.9943 ("high-/way" in every box). L3 canvas-root — a display: contents root's background-image layers reach the canvas on all three platforms (RootBackgroundPropagation + RootBackgroundUniformity; css-backgrounds-3 §2.11.2) → display-contents-root-background ×3 f 0.53 → P 1 / 0.9995 / 0.9989 and background-attachment-margin-root-001 / -002 ×3 f 0.34–0.45 → P ≥ 0.9994; the display: table body gets Chrome's CSS 2.1 §17.2.1 anonymous-cell fixup on the web and SwiftUI canvases (s-11-1-1b-006 web P 0.9941 → 1, iOS 0.9953 → 0.9992, the square at y56–75) — the Compose half REVERTED at the probe. L4 float-avoid — a flow-root beside floats takes the gap the floats leave (FloatAvoidPlan / FloatAvoidLayout on both natives; CSS 2.1 §9.5 + §9.7, css-contain inline-size) → contain-inline-size-bfc-floats-002 iOS / Android f 0.93 → P 0.9985 / 0.9974, bfc-floats-001 and display-flow-root-002 DEGENERATE → faithful (0.9984 / 0.9972; 1 / 1). L5 harness-hygiene — the gate path stops only its own Gradle daemons and adb server (own-processes.sh kill_own_gradle_daemons / kill_wedged_adb_server replace ./gradlew --stop ×2 and pkill -9 -x adb ×2), smoke.sh follows the port guard (vite --strictPort on 3400–3499 when :3000 is foreign) AND builds the Tier-5/11 fixture JSONs it had never built (a fresh worktree failed 90 + 15 probes on fixture-ready-timeout), and the ios-harness XCTest reads its files as bundle resources (project.yml copyFiles) — 30/30 under Xcode 27 (was 17/30 + 13 simulator-blocked).

THE PROBE REVERTED TWO UNITS, BOTH UNDER PRE-REGISTERED RULES (wave53-probe, 20 sections, 2026-10-07 13:42 → 14:39 UTC; tools/titan/results/wave53-gate/probe/). L3 B-android: the pre-declared probeGatedRevert row — s-11-1-1b-006 android drew a 40-px square (an extra empty cell in the Compose anonymous table forest) and moved −0.0038. L1 U2: the geometryGating row counter-suffix android printed GEOMETRY WRONG (rtl row 1 right x126 vs ref x144) while SSIM ROSE 0.9547 → 0.9793 — the Android picture had the baked RTL markers on the wrong rows ("foo" bare, "bar ·", "foo ·", "bar .א", a lone "ב."); iOS and web were right, but M never lands without P and P alone was never pre-registered, so the unit went and its hunk-P gains (bidi-lines-001 android f 0.8934 → P 0.9629, -002 +0.028) with it. The lane's web-composited replay had predicted 0.9900 on Android: a replay never runs the native text layout, and a score cannot see a wrong picture that keeps the ink — the geometry probe can. Both decisions were pre-registered for the closing gate (expectations.json probeDecisions: predictions withdrawn from R4, cells held to must-not-move, carriers withdrawn in the control — and shown to fail on the probe tree itself).

WHAT THE INSTRUMENTS LEARNED. The wire control gained a "renumbered" class: the extractor numbers a section's components with one running counter, so a carrier that gains components renumbers every later document's ids (U1: +1 over 10 css-lists documents; U2 had +6 over 15 cssom documents) — control-check.mjs admits the class only when the uniform shift equals the running component-count delta of the content-changed documents before it in tests.list order. The S1 skeptic found L3-A not independently revertible (its revert order B-android → B-ios → B-web → A and an A-only patch were pre-registered; not needed) and the L1 wire radius under-reported (fixed in the generator). The hh-probe measured the shared tree with every lane's unseamed edits rather than L5's alone (deviation recorded; the union control held).

PREDICTION RECORD. 17 gating floors measured, 17 met (counter-suffix ×3 and 006 android withdrawn by the reverts); L2 and L4 landed exactly as predicted; L3 three of four units; L1 one of two. Pre-existing, found and queued, not ours: hyphens-out-of-flow-002 web f 0.9411 unchanged since wave52-ship (box 4 at 26 px — the web runtime).
